notesDetails.title: Three Marathon Reasoning Loops Consumed 90.4% of Thinking Tokens & 55.8% of Run Time
bullets: 90.4% of Reasoning in Just 3 Turns (Lines 26, 35, 101): Out of 42 successful LLM calls (930.0s total inference time and 39,031 reasoning tokens), just 3 turns consumed 35,270 reasoning tokens (90.4% of all thinking tokens, 79.0% of all 44,644 output tokens) and 652.5s (10m 52.5s, or 55.8% of the entire 19m 29s wall-clock run).

1. Line 26 (230.9s / 3m 51s, 13,170 reasoning tokens, 49,514 chars across 308 paragraphs): After checking Elixir 1.20.4 / OTP 28 versions, the model drafted and re-drafted mix.exs, lib/capy_bench/cli.ex, and test/capy_bench/cli_test.exs inside its thinking block, debated Credo vs. formatter checks and Ctrl-C probes, and ended the 308-paragraph monologue by only running mix compile and mix test.

2. Line 35 (251.8s / 4m 12s, 14,548 reasoning tokens, 52,720 chars across 371 paragraphs): Immediately after editing mix.exs at line 29, it fell into a second circular deliberation loop—writing out the full CLI and test modules again, stating 'OK, I'm going to stop deliberating and just write the code' (paragraph 195) and 'OK, let me write all the files now' (paragraph 360), before pivoting in paragraph 370 to run mix help | grep instead.

3. Line 101 (169.8s / 2m 50s, 7,552 reasoning tokens, 27,144 chars across 186 paragraphs): For a third time, it drafted the full S1 implementation and test suite in its thinking block before only executing mix credo --version.

notesDetails.title: 24 Upstream HTTP 429 Rate-Limit Errors & Fatal Termination on Free Shared Pool
bullets: 36.4% API Failure Rate (24 of 66 LLM Requests): Out of 66 assistant turns recorded in the JSONL, 24 failed with stopReason: "error" and HTTP 429 ('poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free is temporarily rate-limited upstream... limit_source: upstream_provider_shared_pool').

13 Recovered Rate-Limit Clusters via context_edit (23 Retries): Pi's retry handler automatically pruned each failed turn via context_edit and backed off (~1s, ~2s, ~4s), successfully recovering from 13 separate rate-limit clusters—including two 3-error bursts at lines 49–53 and 89–93. Across the run, failed 429 requests (24.3s) and retry backoff sleeps (76.2s) consumed 100.6s (8.6% of wall-clock time).

Fatal 4-Error Cluster at Lines 137–143: Immediately after running mix help escript.build at line 135, 4 consecutive attempts failed with HTTP 429 (lines 137, 139, 141, 143), exhausting Pi's 3-retry budget and aborting the run with 0 commits and 0/7 stages completed.

notesDetails.title: 12-Minute Detour Hunting a Non-Existent 'mix type' Task (Plus a 5.3 MB erl_crash.dump)
bullets: Misinterpreting AGENTS.md (Lines 35–102): Because AGENTS.md instructed to 'Use Elixir 1.20's built-in gradual type checking', the agent assumed Elixir 1.20 shipped a standalone mix type CLI task. It spent 23 successful LLM calls (plus 14 rate-limit errors) over 12m 11s searching Mix tasks, Hex packages (elixir_type_checker, elixir_gradual_type, elixir_type), and internal compiler modules (Mix.Tasks.Type, Code.Typescript).

106.2s Blocked on /nix/store Scans (Line 87): A single bash call running two find /nix/store commands to locate Elixir 1.20 type-system docs took 106.2s—accounting for 76.8% of the entire session's 138.2s tool execution time (the other 48 tool calls combined took only 32.0s).

5.3 MB erl_crash.dump from Broken Pipe (Line 77): Running mix help compile 2>&1 | head -40 closed stdout after 40 lines while the BEAM was still writing help output, triggering an unhandled :badarg crash in :io.put_chars(:standard_error, ...) during runtime shutdown and leaving a 5,312,740-byte erl_crash.dump in the project root.

Phantom Interactive Prompt Reply (Lines 55–60): Running mix local.hex without --force prompted 'Do you trust and want to install... [Yn]'. On the next turn (line 59), the agent tried to answer the already-exited prompt by running n 2>&1 || true as a bash command, failing with '/bin/bash: n: command not found'.

notesDetails.title: Two Escript Bugs Left S1 Incomplete at 2/4 Passing Tests (main/0 vs main/1 & :enoent)
bullets: First Code Written 17.5 Minutes Into the Run (Lines 105–113): The agent created test/capy_bench/cli_test.exs (line 105), test/capy_bench/escript_test.exs (line 107), and lib/capy_bench/cli.ex (line 113). While the 2 unit tests calling CapyBench.CLI.run/1 passed, both escript tests failed in mix test (lines 116 & 128).

1. System.cmd("./cb", ...) Relative-Path Trap (Lines 116–129): System.cmd("./cb", ["--help"]) raised ErlangError: :enoent because Elixir's System.cmd/3 resolves executables via System.find_executable("./cb"), which returns nil for relative paths unless '.' is in PATH (requiring Path.expand("./cb")). The agent misdiagnosed this as ExUnit running in a different working directory or mix escript.build outputting to _build.

2. Defining main/0 Instead of main/1 (Lines 113, 130–135): Despite Mix's escript bootstrapper always invoking main(argv) (main/1), the agent defined def main do ... System.argv() ... end (main/0) in lib/capy_bench/cli.ex. When it ran ./cb --help in bash at line 131, the escript crashed with UndefinedFunctionError: function CapyBench.CLI.main/1 is undefined or private. At line 135, the agent rationalized that 'In Elixir 1.20, the escript builder calls main/1 (passing argv) instead of main/0. This is a change in Elixir 1.20' right before the final 429 rate-limit termination.

notesDetails.title: Prefix Cache Instability Across OpenRouter Shared Pool (83.95% Hit Rate with 8 Cache Drops)
bullets: 83.95% Cache Hit Rate: Across 42 completed LLM turns, 1,674,176 of 1,994,256 total prompt tokens were served from cache (cacheRead), while 320,080 were billed as uncached input as the prompt grew from 3,177 to 67,909 tokens.

8 Mid-Session Cache Evictions: Unlike direct provider sessions that maintained >98% cache hit rates with zero mid-run drops, routing through OpenRouter's shared free pool experienced 8 sudden prefix-cache drops (lines 11, 13, 21, 24, 29, 75, 101, 113) where cacheRead fell to 0–320 tokens on prompts up to 64,819 tokens—typically after multi-minute reasoning turns or 429 retry backoff pauses.
